# 1a. BYZ: avoid suicidal early offensive wars while Fate of the Phoenix disaster is active.

    attacker_potential = {

    target_trigger = {
        NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:attacker }
    }
    multiplier = {
        add = -0.85
    }
    score = {
        add = -250
    }
}

                area = area:west_anatolia_area
            }
        }
    }
    score = {
        add = 35
    }
}

# ==============================================================================
# Dynamic Anti-Hegemon Counter-Balancing Layer (Slot 67 = heg; Rule #10 gated)
# ==============================================================================

# Anti-Hegemon Behavior 1: STOP INFIGHTING between threatened major peers in the same threat circle.
# Standard: -120 score (-0.50 mult); High-Intensity rule: -180 score (-0.70 mult).
oe_heg_ai_stop_infighting = {
    attacker_potential = {
        oe_heg_ai_is_threatened_major = yes
    }
    target_trigger = {
        NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:attacker }
        oe_heg_ai_is_threatened_peer = yes
    }
    multiplier = {
        add = -0.50
        if = {
            limit = { oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_high = yes }
            add = -0.20
        }
    }
    score = {
        add = -120
        if = {
            limit = { oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_high = yes }
            add = -60
        }
    }
}

# Anti-Hegemon Behavior 3a: RESTRAIN SUICIDAL SOLO ATTACKS when the hegemon is healthy (oe_ent_index < 60)
# and at peace, and the individual AI is clearly weaker (< 0.85x) without sovereign allies.
oe_heg_ai_no_solo_suicide = {
    attacker_potential = {
        oe_heg_ai_is_threatened_major = yes
        oe_heg_ai_hegemon_high_entropy = no
    }
    target_trigger = {
        has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target
        trigger_if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target }
            global_var:oe_heg_ai_target ?= this
        }
        at_war = no
    }
    never_attack = {
        "scope:attacker.relative_military_strength(scope:target)" < 0.85
        NOT = {
            scope:attacker = {
                any_related_country = {
                    type = alliance
                    is_subject = no
                }
            }
        }
    }
    multiplier = {
        if = {
            limit = { "scope:attacker.relative_military_strength(scope:target)" < 0.85 }
            add = -0.60
        }
    }
    score = {
        if = {
            limit = { "scope:attacker.relative_military_strength(scope:target)" < 0.85 }
            add = -160
        }
    }
}

# Anti-Hegemon Behavior 3b: OPEN COUNTER-STRIKE WINDOW when the hegemon enters High Entropy (oe_ent_index >= 60)
# or is bogged down in war!
oe_heg_ai_counterstrike_score = {
    attacker_potential = {
        oe_heg_ai_is_threatened_major = yes
        at_war = no
        stability >= 0
    }
    target_trigger = {
        has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target
        trigger_if = {
            limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg_ai_target }
            global_var:oe_heg_ai_target ?= this
        }
        OR = {
            oe_heg_ai_hegemon_high_entropy = yes
            at_war = yes
        }
    }
    score = {
        add = 45
        if = {
            limit = { oe_heg_ai_hegemon_high_entropy = yes }
            add = 45
        }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_rule_is_hegemon_ai_high = yes }
            add = 30
        }
    }
}
